sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 1m
sources.fact: Approximately 99% of England is covered at 1 m resolution; the dataset is a bare-earth DTM in EPSG:27700 with WCS access and ±15 cm RMSE source-survey accuracy.
sources.limit: Survey dates vary spatially and published RMSE is not a parcel-specific confidence interval.

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 2m
sources.fact: The official 2 m composite preserves bare-earth terrain semantics and National Grid alignment for resolution-sensitivity comparison.
sources.limit: The 2 m layer cannot replace the pinned 1 m parcel metric.

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
sources.fact: An official 10 m composite DTM is available as a coarser bare-earth product in the same national reference family.
sources.limit: Ten-metre resolution is unsuitable for primary sub-metre parcel measurement.

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
sources.fact: Time-stamped DTM tiles expose survey date, resolution, transformation and geoidal-model lineage for site-specific checks.
sources.limit: Historical surveys cannot be mixed without explicit date, transformation and geoid checks.

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) 1m
sources.fact: The official 1 m DSM includes surface objects and is available in EPSG:27700 with WCS access.
sources.limit: DSM values must not be substituted for the bare-earth DTM height-difference metric.

sources.name: Persistent WCS endpoint announcement
sources.fact: Environment Agency elevation delivery moved toward persistent open-standard WCS and WMS endpoints without annual year suffixes.
sources.limit: Endpoint policy does not prove correctness of an individual GetCoverage response.

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset
sources.fact: The dataset provides indicative registered-freehold extents by local authority, with unique Land Registry INSPIRE polygon identifiers.
sources.limit: INSPIRE polygons are indicative and are not legal title plans.

sources.name: INSPIRE current monthly download
sources.fact: The current INSPIRE package was published 5 July 2026 and files are replaced on the first Sunday of each month.
sources.limit: Freshness must be revalidated after the next monthly publication.

sources.name: Technical guidance for GML files
sources.fact: Source polygons are captured in British National Grid EPSG:27700; reprojection to WGS84 can shift some features by up to 15 m.
sources.limit: Exact containment and raster sampling must remain in native British National Grid.

sources.name: Use Land and Property Data catalogue
sources.fact: INSPIRE Index Polygons are listed as free, Open Government Licence, monthly GML data.
sources.limit: Catalogue metadata does not prove the bytes of a specific authority package.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 documentation
sources.fact: OS Terrain 50 is an open DTM updated annually in July and supplied as 10 km National Grid tiles with 50 m post spacing.
sources.limit: Landscape-scale resolution cannot validate a sub-metre parcel span.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 overview and accuracy
sources.fact: Terrain 50 is a lower-resolution bare-earth DTM for large-area analysis; grid accuracy is published as 4 m RMSE.
sources.limit: Four-metre RMSE supports gross-outlier screening only.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 technical specification
sources.fact: Grid and contour products share source data, use 10 km tiles and are supplied in documented open formats including ASCII and GML.
sources.limit: Specification text does not prove integrity of a particular downloaded archive.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data specification
sources.fact: ASCII grid tiles contain 200 by 200 cells at 50 m spacing and height values are associated with grid positions.
sources.limit: Current archive headers and raster bytes still require direct verification.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 metadata specification
sources.fact: Per-tile metadata follows documented conventions and records product, spatial representation and tile reference.
sources.limit: Metadata cannot replace hashes of the archive and raster payload.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
sources.fact: Source terrain is captured as a TIN using mass points and breaklines; grid and contour forms are interpolated and generalised.
sources.limit: Interpolation and generalisation reinforce the coarse crosscheck-only role.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
sources.fact: Online supply is available without registration and the national tiled inventory is distributed in documented folders.
sources.limit: Availability does not prove that required TQ archive bytes were obtained in this runtime.

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 GML feature types
sources.fact: GML geometries identify EPSG:27700 and height values reference Newlyn or another applicable British height datum.
sources.limit: Release-specific identifiers are not stable evidence across refreshed tiles.

sources.name: National Grid Transformation OSTN15
sources.fact: OSTN15 is the national grid transformation between ETRS89 and OSGB36 and avoids relying on a single approximate Helmert transformation.
sources.limit: Display-coordinate conversion must not replace native EPSG:27700 parcel sampling.

sources.name: National Geoid Model OSGM15
sources.fact: OSGM15 converts ETRS89 ellipsoid heights to orthometric heights; mainland output is compatible with Ordnance Datum Newlyn.
sources.limit: A geoid model does not prove that source raster values were transformed correctly.

sources.name: EPSG 27700 registry definition
sources.fact: The registry identifier resolves to OSGB36 / British National Grid, a projected CRS with authority code 27700.
sources.limit: A CRS identifier does not prove correct transformation or sampling.

sources.name: Web Coverage Service standards catalogue
sources.fact: WCS Core defines mandatory service requirements while CRS, scaling, range subsetting and interpolation are separate extensions.
sources.limit: Standards text does not prove that a specific endpoint returned correct parcel values.

sources.name: WCS 2.0.1 executable compliance test suite
sources.fact: The suite tests GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage plus mandatory schemas and extension conformance classes.
sources.limit: The generic suite is not evidence that the Environment Agency endpoint was certified by it.

sources.name: WCS 2.1 Core standard
sources.fact: WCS 2.1 Core retains applicability of WCS 2.0 service extensions and formal coverage-access operations.
sources.limit: Version compatibility does not prove a service response's numeric correctness.

sources.name: EO WCS application profile
sources.fact: The profile normatively depends on range subsetting, scaling and interpolation extension contracts.
sources.limit: An application profile does not establish which extensions a specific EA endpoint implements.

sources.name: WCS interpolation extension notice
sources.fact: Interpolation affects subsetting, scaling and CRS transformation and can interact with accuracy and rounding.
sources.limit: A standards notice does not establish the interpolation method of a specific response.

checks.name: SAFE_SYNC_NO_HARD_RESET
checks.detail: Operator recovery preserves dirty/untracked state with stash, atomic fetch, ancestry check and merge --ff-only; hard reset is forbidden.

checks.name: SINGLE_RUNNER_PROCESS_GUARD
checks.detail: Restart helper blocks multiple canonical processes or daemons and does not start a second process when one is active.

checks.name: REV16_BLOB_PIN_SET
checks.detail: Queue and recovery verifier pin the helper, operator, carrier, entrypoint, numeric gate, metric guard, Terrain50 chain and web verifier blob identities.

checks.name: EXACT_TARGET_NO_FALLBACK
checks.detail: Rows 30762, 46142 and 61522 are mandatory; nearest-row fallback remains disabled.

checks.name: PINNED_EA_COVERAGE_AND_STAGE_ORDER
checks.detail: The exact EA DTM1m CoverageId is required and the current height metric guard executes before Terrain50 and port8012.

checks.name: METRIC_DRIFT_FAIL_CLOSED
checks.detail: Current max-minus-min must match preserved results within 0.001 m; median elevation remains a separate field.

checks.name: TERRAIN50_ACCURACY_SCREEN
checks.detail: OS 4.0 m RMSE plus EA 0.15 m RMSE preserve 4.15 m and 8.30 m conservative screens, explicitly not confidence intervals.

checks.name: LOOPBACK_WEB_EXACT_BINDING
checks.detail: Web verification requires loopback port8012, current local candidate SHA, exact row/HMLR/metric bindings and at least 1036 full-site rows.

checks.name: FOUR_RECEIPT_QUORUM
checks.detail: Recovery remains fail-closed until receipts 015, 016, 014 and 003 are all observed by remote readback.

checks.name: BUSINESS_PROMOTION_GUARD
checks.detail: No current business rows or final-ready promotion may occur while owner/heartbeat and four recovery receipts remain absent.
